notes.title: Hot Brass: Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/5a2460a68765b725ff366fab0d01beb4f1ce6ab7.jpg[/img]

Hi all,

We've just pushed version 2.0.11 live!

Along with fixes for a number of reported issues, this patch contains new equipment and a new mission/arcade map! All of the new equipment is unlocked via brand new challenges, each of which also has a corresponding new Steam achievement!

Keep reading for more information about the new content!


[h1][u]Primary Weapons[/u][/h1]

[h2]M4[/h2]
A semi-automatic carbine with a penchant for [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stopping_power#Overpenetration]overpenetration[/url]. The M4 will shoot through walls, doors, obstacles, armor and targets until it is sufficiently slowed. Please be careful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/512e6a584b27b2c02141e121b48d194f3983a046.png[/img]


[h2]Model 700[/h2]
Like the M4, the Model 700 will penetrate most objects. Its lower rate of fire is offset by incredibly high damage, and a scope that grants operators an extended forward-facing viewing range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/6fd3181f6426833c3abded8bf54efff1f46eff43.png[/img]


[h2]Less Lethal Bean Bag Shotgun[/h2]
While having a lower rate-of-fire and ammo-capacity than the OC-Ball, the Bean Bag Shotgun stuns suspects for longer, and reduces their morale with each impact. Encouraging suspects to comply faster.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/8d74a2aeae82a18a55fb572f43537d4baa92c717.png[/img]


[h1][u]Secondary Weapons[/u][/h1]

[h2]G17[/h2]
A suppressed 9mm pistol that greatly minimises the risk of alerting non-line-of-sight suspects while firing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/40614501897c5cc316e88954dae37afa614dd93d.png[/img]


[h2]Less Lethal X26[/h2]
A projectile taser with a 10m range that must be reloaded after each use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/50bcc550f583c96a5b8e4066aeec8bcf17f3784e.png[/img]


[h1][u]Gadgets[/u][/h1]

[h2]Stinger[/h2]
A less lethal explosive device that launches rubber pellets [i]everywhere[/i] upon detonation. Ensure you are behind cover after throwing a Stinger. You have been warned.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/ea4eaa923fbe04217d7401fcd57a39f43568e729.png[/img]


[h1][u]New Mission: Calefaction[/u][/h1]

The update also features a brand new mission (and arcade map), Calefaction: Prevent a robbery at the Near West bank by a well-trained, well-equipped crew led by former military servicemen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/f3e6b7603ea979a34d9f9e57fd1e1343c2106afe.png[/img]


[h1][u]Additions and Changelog[/u][/h1]

Finally, we've also added a "Reset Mission Progress" button in the Profile menu. This allows you to reset your mission progress while retaining your unlocked equipment.

We look forward to hearing your feedback, and as always [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/892860/discussions/0/3114773449960502485/]please report any bugs you find in this thread[/url]!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added 3 new primary weapons, 2 new secondary weapons and 1 new gadget
[*] Added Calefaction mission and Near West Bank arcade map
[*] Added challenges and achievements for new equipment
[*] Added "Reset Mission Progress" button to Profile menu
[*] Fixed issues when binding Left Alt to an action
[*] Fixed suspect torches not turning off on clients when detained
[*] Fixed suspects appearing to be wounded when shot over while compliant on clients
[*] Fixed triggering an infraction when tasing a valid-NPC while they are overlapping an invalid-NPC
[*] Fixed Hostiles Only suspects automatically hunting players
[*] Fixed grenade stash not showing up on clients
[*] Fixed flashing more than 3 NPCs with a single flashbang not completing the flash-3 challenge
[*] Fixed being able to slide over the motel pool
[*] Fixed area between train carriages that players could get stuck
[*] Fixed a few (rare) miscellaneous errors on clients
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Brass: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/5db8e3ed981a5f818b1bdf924d589f522dfdd25a.jpg[/img]

Hi all,

[b]We've just pushed version 1.0.9 live![/b]

This patch contains fixes for a number of reported issues. While this patch doesn't address text chat, we are aiming to release another one in the next day or two that will make text chat a little easier (and more useful).

Version 1.0.9 contains a couple of important changes to gameplay based on player feedback:
[list]
[*] [b]NPCs blocking doors from opening: [/b]When an NPC is blocking a door from opening, the player will now apply all of their might to the door, smashing it and stunning the NPC in the process. While this may not be a perfect solution, it feels like the best of our options. And because this doesn't occur too frequently, our hope is that it's a bit exciting for players when they do see the opportunity?
[*] [b]NPCs blocking everywhere else:[/b] Players can now step over all compliant NPCs (previously it was just detained). This means that once an NPC no longer poses a possible threat (ignoring that they may pick up another firearm), players can move past them to deal with more pressing threats.
[*] [b]Tase buffers:[/b] We've made some tweaks to how taser infractions are calculated, to be a little more tolerance of errant presses, particularly for players who favour tasing in short bursts. Note: All previous tasing rules still apply. However players who accidentally tase after an NPC has become compliant should find they avoid an infraction if they (reasonably promptly) correct themselves now.
[/list]
We'd of course love to hear your feedback on all of these changes, and thanks everyone for your feedback and bug reports so far! We're reading all of them, so if something you've reported hasn't been fixed yet, we do intend to get to it!

Incidentally, we've had a number of players report the AI essentially stopping after prolonged play. If anyone experiences this in the future, it would be incredibly useful to use if you could provide us with game logs. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/892860/discussions/0/3114773449960502485/]There are instructions on obtaining the logs here[/url]. (Important: You must follow those steps before you quit!)

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/892860/discussions/0/3114773449960502485/]Please report any bugs you find in this thread![/url]

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed how the game displays in 16:10 resolutions
[*] Fixed bushes rustle sound on client when stepping over NPCs
[*] Changed sorting order of some minimap icons so they can't be hidden by others
[*] Fixed melee enemies being able to punch in smoke
[*] Fixed NPCs blocking doors (player smash)
[*] Compliant NPCs can now be stepped over
[*] Adjusted how tase infractions are calculated
[*] Fixed NPCs picking up a weapon but not becoming hostile
[*] Fixed rare occurrence of NPCs not becoming compliant when they should
[*] Fixed error on clients that would cause them to teleport to the corner of the map
[/list]

notes.title: Calling all units: the open beta is live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/7cdabc446697aa1b3f2458db85ab5e64cedd5dfe.png[/img]

[h1]Report in to the Open Beta: experience the tension, danger & tactics of a SWAT operator[/h1]

The Hot Brass Open Beta is live and calling all units! Gather your squad and report in today. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HCtou82lqxc&feature=youtu.be

[h1] What's in the Open Beta?[/h1]

The Open Beta features two training missions to show you the ropes. After you hone your skills, you'll deploy straight to the field with the Hammond Kidnapping mission. If you participated in our Closed Alpha, you'll recognize some of these maps. We're taken your feedback and made several changes in the Open Beta: notably, the Hammond Kidnapping now features more randomness for enhanced replayability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/01adb97d14058e7fad165dfd555be67d5dcfeaf8.gif[/img]

The beta may be particularly challenging as you face tense and dangerous situations. Work together with friends to clear the levels: the more cohesive your squad, the higher your chance of success!
We've attached two keys below: one for you and one for a friend. You can play solo, locally with friends, or with others online.

[h1]How to redeem your Steam keys[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/b0d1f42fae9c18ccded15bcaa167f6a2192b08c5.gif[/img]

Open up your Steam client and select "Add a game" from the lower left-hand corner. Click the middle option: "Activate a Product on Steam." Next, you'll follow the prompts. Once you get to the "Product Code" section, paste your code to unlock the Open Beta.

[h1]How to submit your feedback[/h1]

Hot Brass is still in development. Since this is an Open Beta, you may encounter issues. Your feedback is valuable: we'll use it to polish Hot Brass for its final release. We hope you'll share your experiences with us via the feedback form. We'll be collecting your [url=https://www.hotbrassgame.com/feedback]feedback through this form.[/url] Your support is priceless: thank you for the help.

notes.title: Hot Brass Open Beta Coming February 20
notes.content:
Prepare yourself for the tension, danger and tactics of a SWAT operator in Hot Brass!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/a07a5a2c376e371a61f6e46dd95989ab16a08c14.png[/img]

The game will move into Open Beta on February 20, 2020. Sign up now on [url=https://mailchi.mp/b0739d04c974/openbeta][b]hotbrassgame.com[/b][/url] to secure your spot!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HCtou82lqxc&feature=youtu.be

[h1]What’s in the Open Beta?[/h1]
The Open Beta features two training missions to show you the ropes, as well as the Hammond Kidnapping mission. All of which feature in the final game!

If you played our Closed Alpha a couple months ago, you’ll recognize some of these maps. We’ve taken your feedback from that Alpha and made several changes in the Open Beta that we think you’ll enjoy. Notably, the Hammon Kidnapping now features more randomness, to enhance replayability! You’ll have to tackle this additional challenge as you’re called upon to adapt to new circumstances, even in familiar areas. You can keep coming back to the same levels to increase your SWAT prowess!"

[h1]A Note on Difficulty[/h1]
We’re experimenting with mid-game level difficulty in the Open Beta. While Hot Brass is always a game that creates tension as you face dangerous situations, the beta may be particularly challenging for new players (or even those who played the Alpha). We encourage you to play with friends so you can work together to clear these levels.

Let us know what you think! We’ll use your feedback to perfect the difficulty balance for the final game.

[h1]How can I get involved?[/h1]
Sign up on [url=https://mailchi.mp/b0739d04c974/openbeta]hotbrassgame.com[/url] to secure your spot. We’ll send out Steam codes for everyone who’s signed up when the Beta goes live on February 20. Everyone will get one code for themselves, and one extra one to give to a friend!

Even in the Beta, you can play with 1-4 players in online and local co-op. These missions are tough, so the better you work together, the higher your chance of a positive outcome.

We hope you’ll share your experiences with us via the feedback form, which will open automatically when you exit the game. You can also share your thoughts in the game’s Steam forum. We’ll be using YOUR feedback to polish Hot Brass up before its final release."

[h1]When is the final game coming out?[/h1]
We’ll be revealing the release date for Hot Brass later this year!

notes.title: Calling all officers: the closed alpha is live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/8f516208069006598ad9a8197847f03402abe7e1.png[/img]

We are thrilled to share our alpha build with you, so you can help us test and improve the game! Check your email for keys.

Hone your skills and finish your training with the tutorial, then deploy straight to the field with a mission. This alpha includes one mission, and a small taste of the features, weapons, gadgets and challenges that you’ll experience in the final game.

You can play solo, locally with friends, or online multiplayer. As the game is still in development, it’s currently balanced for 2 players. We have included a 2nd Steam key so you can recruit your friends for the best play experience!

[url=https://www.hotbrassgame.com/feedback][h1]Report for duty: redeem your Steam keys and submit your feedback[/h1][/url]
As an early alpha build, you may encounter issues such as bugs. Your feedback is valuable: please tell us everything about your experience -- even bugs -- so that we can make this game better together.

[url=https://www.hotbrassgame.com/feedback]This form[/url] is how we'll be collecting your feedback. Your support is priceless: thank you for the help.

[h1]Join the best of the best[/h1]
Hot Brass is a challenging game. In order to succeed, you'll need to work together with your teammates and constantly adjust your plans in the face of new info. Here are some tips from the commander!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/adfac2288f815c5b6f174eec00bec23cfc6dddcd.gif[/img]
[b][u]ASSESS THREATS[/u][/b]
Each mission plays out on a map akin to building plans or schematics, with characters represented by tokens. This design allows you to rapidly identify what suspects are holding and their demeanours. Red means hostile, yellow means neutral and green means compliant. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/01adb97d14058e7fad165dfd555be67d5dcfeaf8.gif[/img]
[b][u]WATCH YOUR SQUAD'S BACK[/u][/b]
In the field, all shots can be fatal! Work as a team, use cover to position yourself. Use doors and walls to shield yourself and don't forget to crouch behind cover as needed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/a403ebdfad0cda4a9c54d288faec67855791f3df.gif[/img]
[b][u]EQUIPMENT FOR EVERY ENCOUNTER[/u][/b]
Use your environment, weapons and gadgets to resolve situations without fatalities. 
Use shout or flash bangs to alert your presence - each scenario will demand that you think and react quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35741637/c41e98745704d95710386653e1dea85c07caa282.gif[/img]
[b][u]CHART YOUR COURSE[/u][/b]
Use the map to help with your strategy! It allows you to identify the best routes before you step into your mission.
